item.title: Online ticket purchasing unavailable after Microsoft CrowdStrike outage
item.description:
Online ticket purchasing unavailable after Microsoft CrowdStrike outage

Online ticket purchasing is currently unavailable due to Microsoft CrowdStrike outage. The museum remains open and visitors can buy tickets in person.

📅 Availability

  • Online tickets: Unavailable – outage caused by Microsoft CrowdStrike issue.
  • In‑person tickets: Available at the museum ticket desk.
  • Now open: The facility is operating for visitors.

🎟️ Visit Options

  • Tickets
  • Membership
  • Group Visits
  • Giant Screen Theater

🏞️ Programs & Events

  • Nat at Night – runs most Fridays.
  • T.G.I.F. starts here – Friday evening programming.
  • Faces of The Nat – celebrating LGBTQIA+ staff this November.

🚗 Parking & Directions
